versions.changelog:
Initial release of douyin-traffics-monitor, a tool for real-time monitoring of Douyin (TikTok China) traffic trends.

- Enables structured JSON access to Douyin's top content by keyword, author posts, video/image comments, and real-time hot list.
- Supports powerful filters: sort by likes or time, filter by duration/content type, configurable time windows, and flexible data limits (up to 10,000).
- Designed for creators, marketers, operators, and analysts needing Douyin data for content research, competitor analysis, trend tracking, or public sentiment.
- Does not require Douyin login; only uses public data via safe third-party API (guaikei.com).
- Command-line usage with four major actions: keyword search, author post fetch, video/comment capture, and hot rank retrieval.
- Returns all results in structured JSON; execution examples and intent routing provided for ease of integration.
